card.name: Inside scientific citations and references
card.fires_on: Pieces of academic citations in science and health text, such as 'al' in 'et al.', digits of a year, author initials, and commas in reference lists. Also fires on the last letter of a gene or factor name like NFκB.

modes.label: Author-year citations
modes.description: Parts of an in-text citation: 'al' after et, or the digits of the year.

modes.label: Reference list entries
modes.description: Author initials, commas and names inside a bibliography entry.
modes.example: 2. Fratzl, P. and R. Weinkamer<<,>> Nature's hierarchical materials.

modes.label: Names in biology text
modes.description: The end of a factor name or a scientist's name in running text.
modes.example: Sen and<< Baltimore>> described the discovery of a transcription factor

card.plain: It lights up on small pieces of reference citations, like the year or author initials, in scientific writing.
